title: MSR-Align: Policy-Grounded Multimodal Alignment for Safety-Aware Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Vision-Language Models with safety policies to prevent 'unethical or unsafe behaviors.' It evaluates and benchmarks 'safety-aware reasoning' across categories such as discriminatory depictions, insulting and harassing behavior, and psychological harm, which are components of ethical alignment and social value systems.
